brief.headline: Push laminate price from ₹385.00/KG down toward ₹250.00/KG (what we pay Silk Polypack) to close the 54.0% gap and save ₹22718 a year.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250.00/KG on laminates, matching our best price from Silk Polypack.
priceAsk.basis: We pay ₹385.00/KG to UFLEX but only ₹250.00/KG to Silk Polypack for the same item — a 54.0% gap. Market asking prices for pharma sachet laminate sit at ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so our target is market-fair and matches what we already pay elsewhere.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay at 30 days instead of 60 in return for part of the price cut.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days early frees up ₹5325 in cash for us, which we can trade for a discount roughly that size.

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge — ₹16492.00 Cr in sales — and we spend only ₹64788, so we're 0.00% of their business and have almost no individual pull. They're growing fast (35.5% a year), so they want new orders we can dangle. They owe a lot — 1.25 times their own cash — which means cash is useful to them and we can offer faster payment for a price cut. Their health score is C (46/100), so they're not in trouble but not flush either; push firmly on price but don't squeeze so hard we lose supply.

evidence.point: Our laminate price is 54.0% above the best price we pay elsewhere

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed converter already supplying FDC on a small scale — proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets (health C 58/100, revenue ₹2755.75 Cr).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specialises in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong backup for laminate supply (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D 31/100).

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global Amcor — high-end pharma laminates, premium pricing but very reliable if UFLEX stumbles.

risks: We're 0.00% of their ₹16492.00 Cr revenue, so on our own we have almost no leverage — bundle more SKUs or a longer commitment to get their attention.
They owe 1.25 times their own cash (₹10152.31 Cr total debt), which is a watch-out for supply continuity — line up Huhtamaki or Constantia as a qualified second source before pushing too hard.
Their health score is C (46/100) — not distressed but not strong — so if we squeeze too much they may walk or cut quality; balance the price push with faster payment and a volume promise.
Current terms are 60 days; offering 30 days frees ₹5325 cash for us but costs us that working float — make sure the price cut is bigger than the cash cost of paying early.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the gap between the ₹385 we pay you and the ₹250 we pay Silk Polypack for laminates — let's talk about volume, faster payment, and a path to that benchmark price.
